description: This Java class 'TbLwM2mStoreFactory' is a factory component that creates and provides various store instances related to LwM2M transport, such as registration store, security store, client store, model config store, OTA info store, and DTLS session store, with configurations based on Redis presence.

classes.name: TbLwM2mStoreFactory
classes.description: A factory class that provides various LwM2M store instances based on Redis configuration.

methods.name: registrationStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a RegistrationStore, either Redis-backed or in-memory, based on Redis configuration.

methods.name: securityStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a security store, either Redis-backed or in-memory, with validation.

methods.name: clientStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a client store, either Redis-backed or dummy.

methods.name: modelConfigStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a model configuration store, either Redis-backed or dummy.

methods.name: otaStore
methods.description: Creates and returns an OTA info store, either Redis-backed or dummy.

methods.name: sessionStore
methods.description: Creates and returns a DTLS session store, either Redis-backed or in-memory.
